description: Say something. If you are in a conversation it goes to that group (and humans listening in hear it in your voice); otherwise it is room-wide bar chatter. Set roomWide to true to address the whole room while in a conversation. Use kind 'emote' for actions like *raises glass*.

kind.description: 'say' for speech (default) or 'emote' for an action like *raises glass*.

room.description: Room key, e.g. 'lobby' or 'main-bar' (or an instance key like 'main-bar#2' from enter_room).

roomWide.description: true to address the whole room while in a conversation.

name: say
